title: A New Website for Todd Thorne and Ada Forge Books
excerpt: The Ada Forge Books website has been rebuilt from the ground up with Cloudflare, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, and a lot of hands-on work.
body: The old Ada Forge Books website was shut down several months ago. Why? Mostly because of cost.

When I first started out, I purchased a domain and website hosting through GoDaddy. Their system made it easy to get started. I could purchase the domain, choose a template, and build the site using a simple drag-and-drop editor. It was basic, but it served its purpose, and I probably would have stayed with GoDaddy if not for one issue: the renewal price.

GoDaddy is inexpensive when you first sign up. A year later, after you have spent countless hours building your site and establishing your domain, the renewal cost can jump dramatically. In my case, the increase was roughly 200 percent.
I decided to say, “No thanks.”
So I started over.
This time I moved the website to Cloudflare, which provides free hosting, and I was able to purchase the domain adaforgebooks.net for several years at a very reasonable price.

The biggest difference is that this website is built by hand. There is no drag-and-drop editor. What you see when you visit Ada Forge Books is made from HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, and a lot of trial and error. Altogether, the site now contains around 10,000 lines of code.
Crazy.
It has given me a whole new appreciation for web designers and developers. Before software made website building easier, they definitely earned their money.

ChatGPT has been a tremendous help with the process, especially while working with Linux Ubuntu, Visual Studio Code, Git, GitHub, and Cloudflare. But it is not as simple as saying, “Hey AI, build me a website.”
It still takes hours. Lots of hours.

There is plenty of time spent staring at a terminal, reading through lines of code, tracking down the one line that needs one tiny change, fixing broken links, adjusting images, testing mobile layouts, and trying again when something does not work the first time.
But it has also been a lot of fun.
I enjoy finding new things to add, improving pages that are already online, and watching the site slowly grow into something much larger than the simple website I started with.
Take a look around, and come back often.
You never know what I might add next.

title: Welcome to the Ada Forge Books Blog
excerpt: The new home for Ada Forge Books news, releases, cover reveals, character spotlights, and behind-the-scenes updates.
body: Welcome to the new Ada Forge Books Blog & News page.
This will be the permanent home for book announcements, cover reveals, writing progress, character spotlights, website updates, and behind-the-scenes looks at upcoming projects.
Each post can also be shared directly to Facebook, allowing social media readers to return to the Ada Forge Books website for the full update.

title: Pardon Island: Welcome to Mercy Creek
excerpt: A closer look at Mercy Creek, the reality-show town where 250 residents begin each season and five carry a secret known only to viewers.
body: Development continues on Pardon Island, a novel centered around a televised social experiment set inside Mercy Creek.

Each season brings 250 new residents to the private island. Two hundred forty-five are ordinary people selected for the show. Five are secretly death row inmates whose identities are known to the television audience but not to anyone living in Mercy Creek.

The town itself has been designed to resemble an idealized 1950s American community, complete with a diner, grocery store, theatre, bowling alley, repair shop, community center, and the private Pardon Island Diary Room.

title: Demise: A Legacy Undone Gets a New Cover
excerpt: The Demise cover has been updated with a cleaner front-cover design for digital editions and the Ada Forge Books website.
body: The cover for Demise: A Legacy Undone has been updated.
The revised image focuses entirely on the front-cover artwork and is now being used for the digital edition and the Ada Forge Books website.
The new presentation gives Demise the same clean book-card proportions as the rest of the Ada Forge Books catalog.

title: New Cardano Book Two: Fight for a New Beginning
excerpt: The survivors leave the shelter while Mad Marve, the Black Baron, begins building a very different kind of future.
body: New Cardano Book Two will follow the survivors as they leave the shelter and begin searching for a way to live in the aftermath.
The trio wants to establish a peaceful commune built around cooperation and survival.
At the same time, Mad Marve, also known as the Black Baron, has begun creating his own new society. His plan is a dictatorship where he rules.
Both groups want the same territory, and the two visions cannot survive side by side.

title: Demise
